layout.title: No balcony door · 98″ corner TV · 5-seat sofa on the west glass · 6-seat dining off the island
notes: With the balcony door gone, the west glass is a full wall: a 133″ five-seat sofa backs onto it, so no strip of floor is stranded behind the sofa.
A 98″ TV on a corner console across the south-east corner faces the sofa on the diagonal, so every seat is within 50° of the screen axis.
The 72″ × 36″ table stays off the island with three chairs a side and 48″ of pull-out room for each.
Plants, side tables, a lamp behind the TV corner and a swivel chair by the lake fill the leftover corners, leaving under 20 sq ft of odd pockets.

verdicts.summary: Cuts pockets from 75–91 sq ft to 19.7 while keeping five seats, six at the table and the 98″; the 26–29° fill is the only real shortfall, and nothing in the room fixes it for less than it costs.
feedback: TV: 26–29° is under the 30° cinema floor, but mostly forced; sliding the sofa 4.5″ off the glass (a gap under 8″ creates no pocket) gains only ~0.5°.
Pockets: a low plant or basket at about (181, 78) and the swivel chair at (100, 25) would trim the total to roughly 12–14 sq ft.
The west chairs' pull-out reaches the sofa's legroom zone; shared use, a squeeze only when both are occupied.
The table sits 1.4″ off the island, so the two north chairs are reached by walking around.
The TV's west edge stands in front of about 11″ of the lake glass (x 135–146).

verdicts.summary: The plan to build: five seats on the glass, a 98″ in the corner, a six-top with 48″ pull-out and 19.7 sq ft of leftovers; every closer screen hits the column, the office route or a much larger empty floor.
feedback: No deductions. Measured alternatives: sofa 14″ east hits the column and pinches the office route to 31″; 98″ on the east wall gives 21–28°; a 4-seat sofa at 8 ft 4 in with the table behind it gives 35–46° but 38.5 sq ft of pockets (scored 7).
Corner TV slid 12″ toward the sofa: 27–30°, 28.1 sq ft of pockets (scored 8). H2 with the door ignored: 78 sq ft, one 73 sq ft piece (scored 6).
Brief error: the largest pocket (6.5 sq ft) is the south-glass strip, not the triangle behind the console (3.7 sq ft).
Brief error: the 14″-console variant's sofa (x 17–55) intersects the column; the lake bay behind a floated sofa is 66.7 sq ft, not about 60.
Seat 5's legroom clears the column by 2.1″ against a traced (not taped) column position: the one tight spot.

verdicts.summary: The best no-door geometry for this room: a modest loss of viewing angle buys back 60+ sq ft of dead floor, with five unobstructed seats, six roomy dining seats and under 20 sq ft of perimeter pockets.
feedback: Seat 1 misses prime by 0.1° of fill and is 34″ from the coffee table; a 60″ × 28″ coffee table at (71, 95) brings it to 26.5″ and trims pockets to 18.8 sq ft.
Moving the tall plant to (186, 86) with that table absorbs the east-wall pocket: 16.5 sq ft in 5 pieces.
Brief error: the largest pocket is the south-glass strip (6.55 sq ft); the console triangle is 3.67 sq ft.
Brief error: H2 with the door removed now measures 78.3 sq ft (the 91.1 predates counting the reading chair's front as used).

verdicts.summary: Maxes the 98″ and six-seat dining while crushing odd pockets, but the long diagonal throw (26–29°) is the main cost, and the in-room moves that widen the picture trade pockets or the office path for it.
feedback: TV: 9–16° below H2's fill; seat 1 sits at the 26° floor with a 39° head turn.
The sofa-console alternative (27–32°, 35.5 sq ft, office 31″) would score about 7.5: not a net win.
No other deductions; eval output matches N1-eval.txt.

verdicts.summary: Fits five sofa seats and generous six-person dining with little stranded floor, accepting a relatively distant TV view.
feedback: No net improvement found; the sofa-console alternative would be about 8.
The prime label on 28–29° seats is the builder's classification, not evidence the distance matches H2's 38–42°.
Match the actual 98″ set's stand feet to the 56″ console before buying.

changes: Goal met in round 1: 4 of 5 councillors at 9 or above, so N1 stands as submitted.

Brief corrections: the largest pocket is the 6.5 sq ft strip along the south glass (the console triangle is 3.7 sq ft); H2 without the door measures 78.3 sq ft once the reading chair's front counts as used; the 14″ sofa-console variant hits the column.

Suggested refinements not applied, because each would be a new submission: a 60″ × 28″ coffee table at (71, 95); the tall plant at (186, 86); a low plant at (181, 78); confirm the column position by tape, since seat 5's legroom clears it by 2.1″.
